overview: The committee met with the City Assessor to evaluate the potential implementation of a residential property tax exemption, focusing on financial modeling and administrative requirements. Members reviewed how the tax shift would affect homeowners, renters, and seniors before requesting further data.

items.title: Implementation of a Residential Property Tax Exemption (Resolution 26-066)
items.summary: Kept in committee and requested additional data after City Assessor Jared Yagjian presented an analysis showing a projected break-even point of $1,150,000 and the potential for a significant tax shift onto large apartment buildings. The committee discussed concerns regarding rental price increases and the need for more granular data on property trusts and impacts to seniors.
